text:
Alex P: Heads up — Bay Area colo reported a regional network blackout, FastAir manifest shows a pallet with 12 H100s stuck at SJC sort. Need impact analysis and RMA plan.
Maria S: Which AWB/forwarder? Any photos from FastAir?
Kevin L: AWB 123-FA-987654, FastAir Logistics. No carrier ETA yet, held at SJC hub per tracking.
Jess T: Affected Dedicated pool = pool-west-2-dedicated-3 (12x H100). Preflight scheduled tomorrow; losing these delays first-day capacity.
Alex P: Can we borrow spares from other regions to cover burst? What's cost + latency hit?
Maria S: We have 6 H100s in EU-spare, 8 in APAC-edge. Cross-region moves add customs and egress. Rough rush cost: ~$12k/unit air + handling.
Kevin L: SupplyBot ran simulation: shifting 6 units from APAC raises median p99 ~35ms for some customers. We can route non-latency-critical traffic to APAC to preserve SLAs for critical routes.
SupplyBot: Automated: routing proposal -> shift non-critical routes to apac-edge, expected reduction ~40% p99 load on pool-west-2.
Jess T: Also need RMA: vendor flagged some units for earlier replacement; forwarder wants serial verification before release. That could add 48-72h if we need depot photos.
Alex P: @Maria S can vendor pre-authorize temporary replacements without depot photos?
Maria S: ZenithSupply says they can pre-authorize 6 temporary replacements if we sign expedited RMA. The remaining units require manifest + photos.
Kevin L: Can we accept temp replacements into Dedicated pools under a quarantine/holdback policy? Accounting and warranty handshake risk.
Jess T: Ops Oncall — can we hot-swap capacity and tag incoming temps as quarantined for inspection?
Ops Oncall: Yes. Rollout plan: 1) shift 30% non-critical to APAC, 2) accept 6 temp units into pool-west-2-dedicated-3 with tag "quarantine-temp", 3) mark incoming 6 units for full depot inspection.
Alex P: Maria, get the provisional AWB for temp replacements and confirm incoterms (DDP/return freight).
Maria S: Vendor provisional AWB: AWB: 123-FA-RT-0001, ETA to SJC hub ~36h for temp shipment. Incoterms DDP for temps; we cover return freight for failed units.
Kevin L: Finance note — immediate rush cost ~ $72k for 6 units. Procurement to reconcile vendor credits later.
Jess T: Also coordinate with colo NOC; blackout caused MGMT VLAN flaps. Bringing temps online requires control-plane coordination to avoid split brains. I'll open runbook: rollout/6799991234-bayarea-temp-swap and tag NOC.
Alex P: Last ask: confirm vendor RMA SLA on pre-auth replacements and whether we get SLA credits for pool downtime. If vendor denies, escalate to procurement.
Maria S: Vendor terms: 48h dispatch for temp after form; SLA credits only for permanent replacements >7 days. Escalating now.
Jess T: Action items: Maria escalate + collect AWB/docs; Kevin produce finance estimate; Ops open rollout + NOC coordination; Alex confirm customer routing priorities. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
